scene_setup: Episode 2 complete — the trio has crossed Breeze Path. Wind banners from Skysong Harbor are a distant memory; ahead, Gym 1 rises on a wind-swept platform above the clouds. Valion, Pashion, and El Haddah finish the last grassy stretch of Breeze Path as gusts grow stronger. The open-air arena of Zephyra's Wind Gym comes into view: pennants whip in the gale, and Gym Leader Zephyra stands at the center with arms spread into the current. She greets the party: 'The Gale Badge isn't won by force — it's earned by balance. Show me you can read the currents, not fight them.' The wind trial begins.

objectives.description: Complete the final stretch of Breeze Path and arrive at Zephyra's Wind Gym
Hear Zephyra's pre-battle dialogue and accept the wind trial challenge
Face Gym Leader Zephyra in the gym_zephyra_wind trial (2 Pokémon per trainer, strong winds)
Win the trial and earn the Gale Badge (badge_gale) — update characters[].trainer.badges and continuity.locations_visited
Post-victory: Zephyra's victory dialogue, badge ceremony, and set next-episode hook toward deeper Celestide Isles

dm_notes: Episode 3 — Gym 1 session. Apply Expansion §09: 2 Pokémon per trainer, strong winds each round, Flying types +1 initiative per round (wind initiative — see kb/regional-variants.md). challenge_id gym_zephyra_wind at zephyra_gym. FAIL-SOFT DEFEAT: if party loses, Zephyra pauses, teaches strategy (read currents, Flying priority), offers immediate retry — no badge penalty, no shame. On victory: award badge_gale to each trainer's badges array, add zephyra_gym to continuity.locations_visited, use challenges.json victory_dialogue. Rotate active_trainer_id among Valion, Pashion, El Haddah. Family-friendly tone. Track Pokédex per Expansion §10.

planned_encounters.notes: Optional final Breeze Path wild (Hoppip or Pidgey lv7-9) before gym arrival. Skip if party is low on resources.

challenge_id: gym_zephyra_wind. Rules: 2 Pokémon/trainer, strong winds, Flying +1 initiative/round. Zephyra team: Pidgeotto lv11, Swablu lv11, Tropius lv13 (signature). Pre-battle: npc_gym_leader_zephyra dialogue from challenges.json. Victory: badge_gale + victory_dialogue. Defeat: fail-soft retry per defeat_dialogue.
